dataRecordMapping.description:
Provides a mapping from a data record returned by an api call, which may be in any shape,
to the shape required by the concrete data spec setting type implementation.

fieldName.description: The name of the field to which these settings apply

value.description: The current value of the field.

defaultValue.description: The default value of the field, if any.

invalid.description: Whether the value in the input is not acceptable as a valid value.

dataPropSpecs.description:
Descriptors for how to obtain the value for a prop from data.
Specifies the path to the data and the prop to populate.

updateOnDataHandleWithContextVar.description:
Whether or not to update the field value when it loads its data if the inputElement utilizes contextVars.
Current behavior for updating is to clear the field's value. The recommendation is to always keep it on true, unless
you are setting a {@link UiSdlFieldSettingBase#dataPropSpecs} on the field that reads data that has been set via {@link UiSdlConnected#derivedProps}.

componentRef.description: Insert a component into this field.

label.description: The label that should appear above the field.

hintText.description: The hint text to be shown below the field.

infoTooltipText.description: The hint text shown in the tooltip (as an info icon).

required.description: Whether or not this field is required.

disabled.description: Whether the field should be disabled.

hidden.description: Whether the field should be hidden.

width.description: Width of the field, int or double as percentage value or UiSdlFormWidth as value with its unit.

maxWidth.description: Max width of the field, int or double as percentage value or UiSdlFormWidth as value with its unit.

title: A specification that describes how to display field set in the {@link UiSdlForm}.
name: UiSdlFieldSetFormFieldSetting
